We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...but in reality, we are a consulting company specialized in IT development and Business improvement. We are active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, Pharmaceutical & Transport.

 

Cream's special recipe

• 1/3 of Personal development

• 1/3 of Collective Intelligence

• 1/3 of Intrapreneurship

And Bonus ingredient: ... Some passionate colleagues ??
What is a Data Engineer at cream?

As a Data Engineer at Cream, you can be in charge of the implementation of BI Business Projects or potentially coaching junior data engineers. As well, be responsible for the development of data ingestion and analytics solutions (data warehouses, data marts, etc.)

 

Your tasks

• Architecting Data Systems: Designing robust and scalable data models to meet business needs

• ETL Development: Creating or improving efficient Extract, Transform, Load processes to integrate and process data

• Performance Optimization: Monitoring and fine-tuning data pipelines and databases For optimal speed and efficiency

• Data Security Implementation: Establishing data security measures to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Working closely with data scientists, analysts, and other teams to understand data requirements and provide technical solutions

• You have at least 2 years experience in data engineering

• You have a Master's degree, preferably in IT (Computer or industrial engineering) or in Business Administration or equivalent by experience (more than 5 years).

• You are used to working with different data tools such as SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, AWS, Azure data factory,  Apache Spark, SQL, Python, Tableau

• You have a good database knowledge (SQL and NoSQL)

• You are fluent in French or Dutch and have full professional capacity in English

• You know what it means to work in an Agile mode

• You are passionate about data, pay attention to details and you bring out concrete analysis to help the business

jobs.description:
What is Cream all about ?

 

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects

Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :

• Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements

• Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT

• Analyze the impact due to required evolutions

• Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations

• Design and document the to-be process

• Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing

• Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders

• Change management and deployment

• Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients

What do we expect from our consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset

• A knowledge of Business Process Modeling (ARIS, Visio, Camounda, UML, ...)

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We're hiring an Operations Shift Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams. Your role:

• You are a natural leader, guiding and inspiring a multidisciplinary team to successfully deliver the production plan.
• You make things happen, turning weekly planning into a clear daily schedule and deploying the right people and resources to get the job done.
• As a coach and motivator, you ensure flawless execution, support your team's growth, and directly impact the success of our operations.
• In this role you report to the Operations Manager and Operations Director.

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
  
 

•  

You have experience in 
B2B customer service, sales support, order management or commercial operations. You enjoy helping people develop while staying involved in the daily work.
  

•  

You bring 
at least five years of relevant experience, including experience directly managing a team.
  

•  

You have coached colleagues, set priorities and followed up on their performance.
  

•  

You understand how customer requests, commercial agreements and internal processes connect.
  

•  

You are comfortable using 
Excel, reports and KPIs to identify problems and decide what needs attention.
  

•  

You have worked with an 
ERP system, such as SAP or Dynamics. 
Salesforce experience is a strong advantage. Training can be considered if your wider experience fits the role.
  

•  

You communicate confidently in 
professional English. German or Italian is a plus.
  

•  

You take initiative, keep track of commitments and involve the right people to get things resolved.

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.

Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For a logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for packing employees who can work in a day shift.

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods.

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination. 

 
• 
You communicate well in English and/or Dutch.

 
• 
You are available to work from 08:00 to 16:15.

 
• 
Physical work is no issue for you.

 
• 
You stay calm under pressure.

 
• 
You are able to keep a good overview of your tasks.

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:

• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)
• Receiving and processing customs documents
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?

• Minimum A2 diploma 
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator
• Able to work independently and manage priorities

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:

• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.
• Able to provide good references.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:

• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:

• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

Our client is an international company active in a Industrial / Manufacturing industry, with operations across Europe and Africa. The organization is currently looking for an HR Freelance Support during a key transition period.

Jobomschrijving

As an HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Manage end-to-end HR operations for multiple countries.
• Coordinate payroll processes using Workday, Officient and external providers.
• Handle employee administration, holiday requests and HR documentation.
• Support payroll activities in Belgium, Denmark and South Africa.
• Ensure compliance with CP207 and internal HR policies.
• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers.
• Support process improvements and maintain HR data accuracy across systems.

As a HR Freelance Support your responsibilities are:

• Proven experience in a broad HR Generalist, HR Manager or HRBP role
• Strong operational HR mindset with a hands-on approach.
• Experience managing international payroll activities.
• Familiarity with Securex and Officient is highly preferred.
• Working knowledge of Workday and HRIS environments.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.
• Able to work independently and start on short notice.
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges

• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.
